objective: Safely reduce memory use for legacy Wall JPEG backfill by decoding RGB (3 bytes/pixel) then converting only <=384px downsample to RGBA before encoding.
productionBaselineEvidence: Source main a73449e7e42dde6897d36d2d12e36197ac7f116f; Supabase worker v5 pilot 3/3 retained prior memory-limit failures; 814 previews remain successful, 209 failed originals intact; worker disabled with zero cron jobs.
chosenApproach: Bound JPEG decode to 24MP and 160 MiB approximate library allocation; RGB output instead of RGBA; validate exact buffer stride; 384px RGBA encoder-only buffer.
selectionRationale: Reduce decoder pixel-buffer usage and avoid paid transformations; known official jpeg-js formatAsRGBA false outputs RGB; keep hard resource caps and existing authentication.
alternativeApproaches: Raise memory bound to 256 or unlimited (rejected: hosting limit and OOM)
Enable Supabase Storage image transformations (rejected: metered and quota unknown)
